title: Minimally angulated pediatric wrist fractures: Is immobilization without manipulation enough?
journal: Canadian Journal of Emergency Medicine (Can J Emerg Med)
design_evidence: This retrospective cohort study was performed at a large urban tertiary care university-affiliated children's hospital.
population: Children with bi-cortical minimally angulated distal metaphyseal radius fractures, alone or in combination with distal ulnar fracture
